text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate + streaming disconnect spike detected for /v1/streams (region: us-west-2). Error spike started ~1799123400. Possible gateway/timeouts/chunked-encoding failures. Pager sent to oncall (maria). https://monitoring.redwood/internal/alerts/1799

maria (oncall): saw it — jumping in. initial ask: any known deploys?

leo (eng-sre): no deploys in the last hour from deploy-bot. stack traces show a lot of proxy 502/504s between api-gateway -> runtime-gw.

anya (eng-runtime): logs from runtime nodes show frequent client-side cancellations + partial chunked frames. suspects: upstream NGINX chunked timeout or long-lived connections hitting LB idle timeout.

james (eng-runtime): paste of tail logs:
```
[2026-03-14T09:10:02Z] stream_id=abc123 status=200 chunks=1
[2026-03-14T09:10:04Z] stream_id=abc123 error=client_cancelled reason=EOF
[2026-03-14T09:10:04Z] proxy=nginx status=502 upstream=runtime-03
[2026-03-14T09:10:05Z] stream_id=def456 status=200 chunks=2
[2026-03-14T09:10:06Z] stream_id=def456 error=upstream_timeout
```

kevin (customer-ops): flag — two enterprise customers reported aborted streams and token refresh errors around 09:10. We should surface customer impact.

support-eng: got a support ticket from Acme with client logs showing repeated reconnects (exponential backoff) and 502s.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale up runtime pool by +30% 2) enable fallback to short-polling for affected routes 3) temporarily increase gateway timeouts 4) coordinate with load balancer team to bump idle timeout. Assigning tasks: leo -> infra scaling & LB, anya -> runtime config, james -> telemetry and rollback gates, kevin -> customer comms.

leo (eng-sre): running scale command now: `./infractl scale runtime-pool --region us-west-2 --count +6` — ETA ~90s. Also raising LB idle timeout from 60s -> 180s for trial.

anya (eng-runtime): pushing a runtime-side mitigation: enable conservative chunk flush (forces a keepalive chunk every 10s) and add graceful drop on half-open connections to avoid proxy-level 502s. Patch config diff: 
```yaml
server:
  chunked_keepalive_seconds: 10
  max_unacked_chunks: 100
  client_cancel_backoff_ms: 200
```
Applying to canary (runtime-03, runtime-04).

james (eng-runtime): telemetry checks: raising sample rate for chunk metrics and adding a trace for client-cancel reasons. running `kubectl rollout status` on runtime canary.

incident-bot: NOTE: customers impacted: acme-corp, beta-inc (high latency/reconnects). SLA risk: degradation of streaming endpoints; non-streaming endpoints stable.

kevin (customer-ops): sending proactive note to affected customers: "We've detected intermittent streaming interruptions in us-west-2; working on mitigation. If you see reconnection loops, please pause clients for 60s while we stabilize." Will include restart guidance and link to status page.

support-eng: patching support KB with temporary workaround: set client linger to 15s and increase HTTP retry windows. adding snippet: `Connection: keep-alive` + retry backoff jitter.

leo (eng-sre): scale completed, runtimes show +6 nodes healthy. LB timeout change applied.

anya (eng-runtime): canary patch succeeded; chunk keepalive is injecting heartbeat chunks. Observed a drop in immediate 502s from runtime-canary. Rolling patch to 40% of traffic.

james (eng-runtime): metrics after canary (5m window): 5xx rate for /v1/streams down from 6.2% -> 2.1%. client_cancelled events still elevated but client reconnection loops reduced.

maria (oncall): good. next: validate long-tail (30m) and watch for any regressions. If 5xx <1% and customer impact drops to zero, we'll close.

leo (eng-sre): note for postmortem: investigate upstream LB idle-time interactions with chunked transfer and confirm whether new runtime keepalive hides root cause. Add eval: simulate long-lived streams + LB idle 60s -> reproduce.

anya (eng-runtime): also want to audit client library: some SDK versions don't respect server-initiated keepalive and cancel too eagerly. james, can we add a flag in the SDK to honor keepalive chunks?

james (eng-runtime): yes — making ticket: RUNTIME-3145 to add keepalive handling. For now we will leave server-side keepalive enabled as a mitigation.

kevin (customer-ops): update: Acme acknowledged our note and reported immediate improvement after we rolled patch.

maria (oncall): escalation criteria: if 5xx >3% for 15m or >1 enterprise customer reports impact, escalate to SEV. Current metrics below that threshold. continuing monitoring.

sre-bot: scheduled postmortem reminder in 24h and created internal incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1799123456

maria (oncall): closing live mitigation phase; will handoff to leo/james for post-incident work and to kevin for customer follow-ups. If anyone sees a regression, ping @maria immediately. :thumbsup:
